papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.28575）：TWIST 提出 conversational memory 评测里尚未被测过的'intervention quality'维度——把 memory 系统作为'self-contained ingest/recall/vet surface'在 belief change points 上做正确性评估，覆盖 4 tracks：unprompted tension detection / vetting outgoing drafts against the record / answering with current state / over-update resistance；并提供 human-validated draft-alignment。这是 context-engineering × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge 的'评测空白填补'方法学资产：现有 memory benchmark 多测 recall / prompted updates，TWIST 补的是'系统作为整体在干预点是否正确'——这与团队'agent 在关键决策点是否能拒绝 / 修订自己输出'的能力直接相关。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 4 tracks 协议、human-validated 数据规模、scoring 是否公开。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'memory intervention quality'checklist 草稿，关注与 28075 'Reliability Routing'、28570 DEEPO 形成'今日评测 × agent 可靠性三联证据'。

papers.title: When Should Forecasting Agents Reason? Behavioral Stress Tests for Reliability Routing
papers.abstract: Forecasting agents increasingly combine language-model reasoning, retrieval, ensembling, and calibration, but it remains unclear when each behavior should be trusted. We study this question on ForecastBench-style binary forecasting tasks, treating the choice to retrieve, reason, defer to a market prior, or use a historical analog as an observable agent behavior rather than a hidden implementation detail. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.28475）：'Behavioral Stress Tests for Reliability Routing'把 forecasting agent 的机制选择（retrieve / reason / defer to market prior / use historical analog）当作可观测的 agent behavior 而非隐藏实现细节，在 ForecastBench 二元预测任务上做'机制选择是 source-dependent'的实证——structured analogs 在某些 source 占主导。这是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 的方法学资产：与 DEEPO（28570）'RL correction chain 双熵治理'形成'今日 agent 可靠性双联证据'——前者是 RL 内部熵治理，后者是 agent 行为级 reliability routing。趋势判断：纳入趋势雷达，与 9 月 25 日 X-Planner（25187）'event-structured planning'一起强化'agent 内部行为可观测化'连续主线。代码/benchmark/项目页：ForecastBench 公开，但论文代码/项目页暂无，需打开 PDF 看实验协议、source breakdown、stress test 维度是否公开。今日动作：趋势卡片维护，做 1 周内多源证据复盘。

papers.title: Adversarial Closed-Loop Curriculum for Evolving Role-Playing Agents
authors: Zheng Zhang, Liu Liu, Qi Chai, Deheng Ye, Peilin Zhao, Mao Zheng, Hao Wang
papers.abstract: Role-playing agents based on large language models have been widely applied in areas such as personalized assistance and social simulation. Recent RL methods typically train on a fixed scenario pool collected before learning begins. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.28609）：AdvRole 是'对抗式上下文重写'框架，把 role-playing agent 的 RL 训练从'固定 scenario pool'升级为'adversarial closed-loop curriculum'——随着 agent 能力提升，原本'难'的场景不再难，但训练分布仍是当初那批，造成 distributional bottleneck；用对抗式改写持续生成'当下仍难'的场景。这是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 的方法学资产：与 DEEPO（28570）'RL correction chain 双熵治理'、28075 'Behavioral Stress Tests'形成'今日 agent 训练分布治理三联证据'——分别覆盖'RL 内部熵治理 × agent 行为级 reliability × 训练分布动态化'三个维度。趋势判断：纳入趋势雷达，与 9 月 23 日 GameHorizon、9 月 25 日 X-Planner 一起强化'agent 训练数据自适应'连续主线。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看对抗改写算法、消融、role-playing benchmark 是否公开。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。

papers.title: Beyond Surface Style: Aligning Multi-Turn User Simulators with Behavioral Consistency

papers.abstract: Faithful user simulation is fundamental to building, evaluating, and improving interactive AI at scale.
